purpose: Track authentic incident records for event extraction, retrieval evaluation, and reviewer-supervised training.

datasets.name: OSHA Severe Injury Reports
datasets.coverage: Federal OSHA severe nonfatal injury reports from 2015 onward
datasets.recommended_use: Primary authentic narrative set for observable event and hazard-term extraction.
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat a report as proof that a specific employer violated a cited rule.
Do not infer a clean case from the absence of a report.
caveats: Covers federal OSHA jurisdiction, not every state-plan incident.
Represents severe reported outcomes, so it is not a sample of normal camera-hours.

datasets.name: OSHA Investigation Summaries
datasets.recommended_use: High-value hard cases for query generation and human-reviewed causal extraction.
prohibited_inferences: Do not manufacture negative examples from unrelated summaries.
Do not map narrative keywords directly to a regulation without checking the case record and scope.
caveats: Not presented as one clean machine-learning table.
Inspection selection and publication create sampling bias.

datasets.name: NIOSH Fatality Assessment and Control Evaluation Reports
datasets.agency: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
datasets.coverage: Detailed investigations of selected occupational fatalities since 1982
datasets.recommended_use: Causal sequence extraction, prevention concept retrieval, and expert-reviewed case memory.
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat recommendations as enforcement findings.
Do not train a model to assign fault or blame from these reports.
caveats: NIOSH FACE is a research program, not an enforcement program.
Cases are selected and do not represent all occupational fatalities.

datasets.name: MSHA Accident, Injury and Illness Data
datasets.coverage: Mine operator and contractor reports from 2000 onward
datasets.recommended_use: Structured mining-domain incident classification and external domain-shift testing.
prohibited_inferences: Do not apply mine-specific patterns to a rail yard without domain review.
Do not equate a reported injury with a proven regulatory violation.
caveats: Mining operations differ materially from general industry and rail operations.
Operator-reported fields may contain reporting and coding error.

datasets.name: FRA Accident and Incident Data
datasets.coverage: Rail equipment accidents, casualties, grade-crossing incidents, and operational data
datasets.recommended_use: Primary rail-domain incident corpus and retrieval vocabulary source.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer a duty-time violation unless the necessary duty records and statutory scope are present.
Do not use post-incident cause codes as inputs when testing pre-incident detection.
caveats: Monthly railroad reporting is governed by 49 CFR Part 225 and has reporting thresholds.
Post-event fields can leak the answer into an early-warning benchmark.

datasets.name: CSB Investigation and Accidental Release Reports
datasets.agency: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board
datasets.coverage: Major chemical investigations and reportable accidental releases
datasets.access: Quarterly data download and public investigation reports
datasets.recommended_use: High-quality chemical process-safety cases for causal extraction and retrieval evaluation.
prohibited_inferences: Do not generalize major chemical accident frequencies to ordinary yard operations.
Do not turn CSB recommendations into legal citations without retrieving the controlling authority.
caveats: The accidental release database begins in March 2020.
Detailed investigations are a small, severity-selected set.

datasets.name: NTSB Aviation Accident Database
datasets.coverage: U.S. civil aviation accidents and selected incidents from 1962 onward
datasets.recommended_use: Optional cross-domain causal-language pretraining, not rail or workplace validation.
prohibited_inferences: Do not report aviation results as industrial safety performance.
Do not use probable-cause text as a pre-incident model input.
caveats: Narrative availability varies by time period and investigative responsibility.
